_comment: Reference instance prices for scripts/cost_model.py. These go stale. Update as_of and the rates rather than letting the script quote a number nobody checked. Linux on-demand, us-east-1, no commitments; real fleets run reserved or spot and pay materially less, so treat every dollar figure here as a ceiling and a relative comparison, not a quote.
pricing_model: linux on-demand, no reserved or spot discount
_usable_memory_note: Fraction of host RAM available to the index after the OS, the allocator, per-request working set and headroom for a rebuild running beside the live index.

c7g.4xlarge.note: closest to the measurement host (aarch64 with NEON+SDOT)

c6i.4xlarge.note: AVX2 path; the int8 kernel uses PMADDWD here, not SDOT

r7g.4xlarge.note: memory-optimised; 4x the RAM per core for catalogs that do not fit
